translations.literal: Jelme Temür was ordered to bring six hundred ninety Hangzhou garrison troops to the capital; the Huai-South Pacification Office's small Mongol troops and northern-returning reconnaissance cavalry were transferred to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: Jelme Temür brought 690 Hangzhou garrison troops to the capital; Huai-South and northern reconnaissance cavalry replaced them.

sentences.zh: 八月，調江南新附軍五千駐太原，五千駐大名，五千駐衛州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, five thousand new-subject troops of Jiangnan were stationed at Taiyuan, five thousand at Daming, five thousand at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In August 5,000 Jiangnan new-subject troops each were posted at Taiyuan, Daming, and Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 又發探馬赤軍一萬人，及夔府招討張萬之新附軍，俾四川西道宣慰使也罕的斤將之，戍斡端。

translations.literal: Again ten thousand reconnaissance cavalry and Pacification Commissioner Zhang Wan's new-subject troops of Kuizhou were ordered led by Sichuan Western Circuit Pacification Commissioner Yeqin to garrison Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Another 10,000 reconnaissance cavalry and Zhang Wan's Kuizhou new-subject troops were sent under Yeqin to garrison Khotan.

sentences.zh: 十七年正月，詔以他令不罕守建都，布吉䴙守長河西之地，無令遷易。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventeenth year, an edict: Teginbahan garrisoned Jiandu, Buqij garrisoned the Changxihe region—no transfers.
translations.idiomatic: In January 1280 Teginbahan was fixed at Jiandu and Buqij on the Changxihe—no transfers.

sentences.zh: 三月，同知浙東道宣慰司事張鐸言：「江南鎮戍軍官不便，請以時更易置之。」

translations.literal: In the third month, Associate Pacification Commissioner Zhang Duo of eastern Zhejiang said: "Jiangnan garrison military officers are inconvenient; please rotate them periodically."
translations.idiomatic: In March Zhang Duo of eastern Zhejiang urged periodic rotation of Jiangnan garrison officers.

sentences.zh: 國制，既平江南，以兵戍列城，其長軍之官，皆世守不易，故多與富民樹黨，因奪民田宅居室，蠹有司政事，為害滋甚。

translations.literal: National institution: after pacifying Jiangnan, troops garrisoned listed cities; their senior military officers were all hereditary without change; therefore many formed factions with wealthy households, seizing civilian fields, houses, and dwellings, corrupting officials' administration—the harm grew extreme.
translations.idiomatic: After the conquest, hereditary garrison commanders had allied with local magnates, seized property, and corrupted administration.

sentences.zh: 鐸上言，以為皆不遷易之弊，請更其制，限以歲月遷調之。

translations.literal: Duo memorialized above, holding that all were evils of non-transfer; he requested changing the system, limiting by years for transfer and reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Duo blamed the harm on permanent tenure and asked for term-limited transfers.

sentences.zh: 庶使初附之民，得以安業也。

translations.literal: So that the newly submitted people might secure their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: So newly submitted populations could live in peace.

sentences.zh: 五月，命樞密院調兵六百人，守居庸關南、北口。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to mobilize six hundred troops to guard the south and north passes of Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In May 600 troops were assigned to Juyong Pass north and south gates.

sentences.zh: 七月，敕更代廣州鎮戍士卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an edict to rotate Guangzhou garrison soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In July Guangzhou garrison troops were ordered rotated.

sentences.zh: 初以丞相伯顏等麾下合必赤軍二千五百人，從元帥張弘範征廣王，因留戍焉。

translations.literal: At first two thousand five hundred Kebek troops under Chancellor Bayan and others followed Marshal Zhang Hongfan against the Guang prince and were left to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Originally 2,500 Kebek troops under Bayan had followed Zhang Hongfan against the Guang prince and stayed as garrison.

sentences.zh: 歲久皆貧困，多死亡者。

translations.literal: Over years all were impoverished; many died.
translations.idiomatic: Years of service left them impoverished with many dead.

sentences.zh: 至是，命更代之。

translations.literal: By this time, rotation was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation was now ordered.

sentences.zh: 復以揚州行省四萬戶蒙古軍，更戍潭州。

translations.literal: Again forty thousand households of Mongol troops of Yangzhou Circuit were rotated to garrison Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou's 40,000-household Mongol force was rotated to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，發炮卒千人入甘州，備戰守。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, one thousand artillery soldiers were sent into Ganzhou to prepare for war and defense.
translations.idiomatic: In October 1,000 artillery troops entered Ganzhou for defense.

sentences.zh: 十二月，八番羅甸宣慰司請增戍卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Eight Tribes Luodian Pacification Office requested increased garrison soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In December the Eight Tribes Luodian office requested more garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 先是，以三千人戍八番，後征亦奚不薛，分摘其半。

translations.literal: Earlier, three thousand had garrisoned the Eight Tribes; later campaigning against Yixi Busi, half were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Originally 3,000 garrisoned the Eight Tribes; half were diverted to the Yixi Busi campaign.

sentences.zh: 至是師還，宣慰司復請益兵，以備戰守，從之。

translations.literal: By this time the army returned; the Pacification Office again requested more troops for war and defense; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign the office requested reinforcements; approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，命萬戶張珪率麾下往就潭州，還其祖父所領亳州士卒，並統之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year, Wanhu Zhang Gui was ordered to lead his subordinates to proceed to Tanzhou, return his grandfather's commanded Bozhou soldiers, and command them all.
translations.idiomatic: In January 1281 Wanhu Zhang Gui went to Tanzhou, recovered his grandfather's Bozhou troops, and took unified command.

sentences.zh: 二月，以合必赤軍三千戍揚州。

translations.literal: In the second month, three thousand Kebek troops garrisoned Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In February 3,000 Kebek troops garrisoned Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，高麗王並行省皆言，金州、合浦、固城、全羅州等處，沿海上下，與日本正當沖要，宜設立鎮邊萬戶府屯鎮，從之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Koryo king and the circuit both said Jinzhou, Hapu, Gucheng, Jeonra, and other places along the coast above and below were directly opposite Japan's vital points; a Frontier Guard wanhu office should be established for encampment garrison; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In October Koryo and the circuit reported coastal prefectures faced Japan; a frontier guard wanhu office was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔以征東留後軍，分鎮慶元、上海、澉浦三處上船海口。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, an edict: Eastern Campaign rear-guard troops were divided to garrison the three embarkation ports of Qingyuan, Shanghai, and Ganpu.
translations.idiomatic: In November eastern campaign rear guards were split among Qingyuan, Shanghai, and Ganpu embarkation ports.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，命唐兀䴙於沿江州郡，視便宜置軍鎮戍，及諭鄂州、揚州、隆興、泉州等四省，議用兵戍列城。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year, Tanggu was ordered at Yangzi River circuit prefectures to place troops for garrison as convenient, and the four circuits of Ezhou, Yangzhou, Longxing, and Quanzhou were instructed to discuss using troops to garrison listed cities.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1282 Tanggu was to post Yangzi garrisons as needed; Ezhou, Yangzhou, Longxing, and Quanzhou were to plan city garrisons.

sentences.zh: 徙浙東宣慰司於溫州，分軍戍守江南，自歸州以及江陰至三海口，凡二十八所。

translations.literal: The Eastern Zhejiang Pacification Office was moved to Wenzhou; troops were divided to garrison Jiangnan from Guizhou through Jiangyin to the three sea mouths—twenty-eight places in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Zhejiang office moved to Wenzhou; 28 garrison posts were set from Guizhou to the three sea mouths.

sentences.zh: 四月，調揚州合必赤軍三千人鎮泉州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, three thousand Yangzhou Kebek troops garrisoned Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In April 3,000 Yangzhou Kebek troops garrisoned Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 又潭州行省以臨川鎮地接占城及未附黎洞，請立總管府，一同鎮戍，從之。

translations.literal: Again Tanzhou Circuit, because Linchuan bordered Champa and unsubdued Li caves, requested establishing a headquarters for joint garrison; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Tanzhou sought a joint garrison headquarters because Linchuan bordered Champa and Li territory.

sentences.zh: 七月，以隆興、西京軍士代上都戍卒，還西川。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Longxing and Xijing soldiers replaced Shangdu garrison soldiers, returning to Western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In July Longxing and Xijing troops replaced Shangdu garrisons and returned west.

sentences.zh: 先是，上都屯戍士卒，其奧魯皆在西川，而戍西川者，多隆興、西京軍士，每歲轉餉，不勝勞費，至是更之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Shangdu garrison soldiers' ordos were all in Western Sichuan, while Western Sichuan garrison soldiers were mostly Longxing and Xijing troops; each year transport provisions could not bear the labor and expense—by this time it was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Shangdu garrisons' families were in Sichuan while Sichuan garrisons came from Longxing and Xijing, causing costly rotation—now reversed.

sentences.zh: 二十年八月，留蒙古軍千人戍揚州，餘悉縱還。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twentieth year, one thousand Mongol troops were retained at Yangzhou; the rest were all released to return.
translations.idiomatic: In August 1283 Yangzhou kept 1,000 Mongol troops; the rest were released.

sentences.zh: 揚州所有蒙古士卒九千人，行省請以三分為率，留一分鎮戍。

translations.literal: Yangzhou had nine thousand Mongol soldiers; the circuit requested at a rate of three parts to retain one part for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Of 9,000 Yangzhou Mongol troops, the circuit asked to keep one-third on garrison.

sentences.zh: 史塔剌渾曰：「蒙古士卒悍勇，孰敢當，留一千人足矣。」

translations.literal: Shi Talahun said: "Mongol soldiers are fierce and brave—who dares oppose them? One thousand men suffices."
translations.idiomatic: Shi Talahun said Mongol troops were so fierce that 1,000 sufficed.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，發乾討虜軍千人，增戍福建行省。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, one thousand Qan-toghrach troops were sent to augment Fujian Circuit garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In October 1,000 Qan-toghrach troops reinforced Fujian.

sentences.zh: 先是，福建行省以其地險，常有盜負固為亂，兵少不足戰守，請增蒙古、漢軍千人。

translations.literal: Earlier, Fujian Circuit because its land was perilous and bandits often held fast and made disorder, with too few troops for war and defense, requested augmenting Mongol and Han troops by one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian had cited rugged terrain and banditry to request 1,000 more Mongol and Han troops.

sentences.zh: 樞密院議以劉萬奴所領乾討虜軍益之。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs discussed augmenting with Liu Wannu's Qan-toghrach troops.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau approved Liu Wannu's Qan-toghrach force.

sentences.zh: 二十一年四月，詔潭州蒙古軍依揚州例，留一千人，餘悉放還諸奧魯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-first year, an edict: Tanzhou Mongol troops following Yangzhou's precedent, retain one thousand men; the rest all released to their various ordos.
translations.idiomatic: In April 1284 Tanzhou Mongols, like Yangzhou, kept 1,000; the rest went home.

sentences.zh: 十月，增兵鎮守金齒國，以其地民戶剛狠，舊嘗以漢軍、新附軍三千人戍守，今再調探馬赤、蒙古軍二千人，令藥剌海率赴之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, troops garrisoning the Gold Teeth kingdom were increased because its households were fierce; formerly Han and new-subject troops of three thousand had garrisoned; now again two thousand reconnaissance and Mongol troops were mobilized, ordered led by Yilaqai.
translations.idiomatic: In October Gold Teeth garrison was reinforced: 3,000 Han and new-subject troops had been insufficient against fierce locals; 2,000 more reconnaissance and Mongol troops under Yilaqai were sent.

sentences.zh: 二十二年二月，詔改江淮、江西元帥招討司為上、中、下三萬戶府，蒙古、漢人、新附諸軍，相參作三十七翼。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-second year, an edict changed the Jiang-Huai and Jiangxi marshal-pacification offices to upper, middle, and lower three wanhu commands; Mongol, Han, and new-subject troops were mixed into thirty-seven wings.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1285 Jiang-Huai and Jiangxi marshal offices became upper, middle, and lower wanhu commands with 37 mixed wings.

sentences.zh: 上萬戶：宿州、蘄縣、真定、沂郯、益都、高郵、沿海，七翼。

translations.literal: Upper wanhu: Suzhou, Qi counties, Zhending, Yitan, Yidu, Gaoyou, coastal—seven wings.
translations.idiomatic: Upper wanhu wings: Suzhou, Qi, Zhending, Yitan, Yidu, Gaoyou, coastal—seven.

sentences.zh: 中萬戶：棗陽、十字路、邳州、鄧州、杭州、懷州、孟州、真州，八翼。

translations.literal: Middle wanhu: Zaoyang, Shizi Road, Pizhou, Dengzhou, Hangzhou, Huai prefecture, Meng prefecture, Zhen prefecture—eight wings.
translations.idiomatic: Middle wanhu: Zaoyang, Shizi Road, Pizhou, Dengzhou, Hangzhou, Huai, Meng, Zhen—eight wings.

sentences.zh: 下萬戶，常州、鎮江、潁州、廬州、亳州、安慶、江陰水軍、益都新軍、湖州、淮安、壽春、揚州、泰州、弩手、保甲、處州、上都新軍、黃州、安豐、松江、鎮江水軍、建康，二十二翼。

translations.literal: Lower wanhu: Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yingzhou, Luzhou, Bozhou, Anqing, Jiangyin naval, Yidu new army, Huzhou, Huai'an, Shouchun, Yangzhou, Taizhou, crossbowmen, militia, Chuzhou, Shangdu new army, Huangzhou, Anfeng, Songjiang, Zhenjiang naval, Jiankang—twenty-two wings.
translations.idiomatic: Lower wanhu: twenty-two wings including Changzhou, Yangzhou, Taizhou, militia, naval units, and others.

sentences.zh: 每翼設達魯花赤、萬戶、副萬戶各一人，以隸所在行院。

translations.literal: Each wing established one darughachi, wanhu, and vice wanhu, subordinate to the local circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Each wing had a darughachi, wanhu, and vice wanhu under its circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十四年五月，調各衛諸色軍士五百人於平灤，以備鎮戍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-fourth year, five hundred colored-troop soldiers of each guard were mobilized to Pingluan for garrison preparation.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1287 500 soldiers from each guard were sent to Pingluan.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔以廣東系邊僥之地，山險人稀，兼江西、福建賊徒聚集，不時越境作亂，發江西行省忽都鐵木兒麾下軍五千人，往鎮守之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict: because Guangdong adjoined strategic frontier land, mountains were perilous and people sparse, and Jiangxi and Fujian bandits gathered and from time to time crossed borders to make disorder, five thousand troops under Jiangxi Circuit's Hudutemür were sent to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: In October 5,000 troops under Hudutemür of Jiangxi were sent to garrison Guangdong against border bandits.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月，調揚州省軍赴鄂州，代鎮戍士卒。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fifth year, Yangzhou provincial troops were sent to Ezhou to replace garrison soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1288 Yangzhou troops replaced Ezhou garrisons.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔黃州、蘄州、壽昌諸軍還隸江淮省。

translations.literal: In the third month, an edict: Huangzhou, Qizhou, and Shouchang troops returned to subordination under Jiang-Huai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In March Huangzhou, Qizhou, and Shouchang forces returned to Jiang-Huai jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 始三處舊置鎮守軍，以近鄂州省，嘗分隸領之，至是軍官以為言，遂仍其舊。

translations.literal: At first the three places had established garrison troops; because they were near Ezhou Circuit they had been divided for leadership—by this time military officers spoke on it, and the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: These three posts had been temporarily under Ezhou; officers now restored Jiang-Huai control.

sentences.zh: 遼陽行省言，懿州地接賊境，請益兵鎮戍，從之。

translations.literal: Liaoyang Circuit said Yizhou bordered bandit territory and requested more garrison troops; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Liaoyang reported Yizhou bordered bandit country and received reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 四月，調江淮行省全翼一下萬戶軍，移鎮江西省。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, one lower-wanhu wing of Jiang-Huai Circuit was transferred to garrison Jiangxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In April one Jiang-Huai lower wanhu wing moved to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 從皇子脫歡士卒及劉二拔都麾下一萬人，皆散歸各營。

translations.literal: Ten thousand men from Prince Toγon's soldiers and Liu Er Badu's command were all dispersed to return to their camps.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 men under Prince Toγon and Liu Er Badu were dispersed to their camps.

sentences.zh: 十一月，增軍戍咸平府，以察忽、亦兒思合言其地實邊僥，請益兵鎮守，以備不虞故也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, garrison troops at Xianping were increased because Chahu and Yiersi said its land was truly frontier; they requested more garrison troops to guard against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: In November Xianping garrison was reinforced as a true frontier post.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，命萬戶劉得祿以軍五千人，鎮守八番。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year, Wanhu Liu Delu was ordered with five thousand troops to garrison the Eight Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1289 Wanhu Liu Delu garrisoned the Eight Tribes with 5,000 men.

sentences.zh: 二十七年六月，調各行省軍於江西，以備鎮戍，俟盜賊平息，而後縱還。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year, troops of each circuit were mobilized to Jiangxi for garrison preparation; after bandits were pacified they would be released to return.
translations.idiomatic: In June 1290 circuit troops were sent to Jiangxi until banditry subsided.

sentences.zh: 九月，以元帥那懷麾下軍四百人守文州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, four hundred troops under Marshal Nahuai were used to guard Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In September 400 of Marshal Nahuai's troops guarded Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 調江淮省下萬戶府軍於福建鎮戍。

translations.literal: Lower wanhu troops of Jiang-Huai Circuit were mobilized to Fujian for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai lower wanhu troops garrisoned Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十一月，江淮行省言：「先是丞相伯顏及元帥阿術、阿塔海等守行省時，各路置軍鎮戍，視地之輕重，而為之多寡，厥後忙古䴙代之，悉更其法，易置將吏士卒，殊失其宜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jiang-Huai Circuit said: "Earlier when Chancellor Bayan and Marshals Aju and Atahai held the circuit, each route placed garrison troops according to local weight—more or fewer; afterward Mangγut replaced them and completely changed the law, replacing commanders, officials, and soldiers—greatly losing fitness.
translations.idiomatic: In November Jiang-Huai reported Bayan, Aju, and Atahai had sized garrisons to local needs, but Mangγut's replacement of all commanders had upset the balance.

sentences.zh: 今福建盜賊已平，惟浙東一道，地極邊惡，賊所巢穴，請復還三萬戶以鎮守之。

translations.literal: Now Fujian bandits are pacified; only the Eastern Zhejiang circuit, land extremely frontier and wicked, bandit nests—please restore thirty thousand households for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: With Fujian pacified, Eastern Zhejiang alone needed 30,000 households restored.

sentences.zh: 合剌帶一軍戍沿海、明、臺，亦怯烈一軍戍溫、處，劄忽帶一軍戍紹興、婺州。

translations.literal: Qaradai's army garrisoned the coast, Ming, and Tai; Yeqile's army garrisoned Wen and Chu; Jaqutai's army garrisoned Shaoxing and Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qaradai garrisoned the coast, Ming, and Tai; Yeqile held Wen and Chu; Jaqutai held Shaoxing and Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 其寧國、徽州初用士兵，後皆與賊通，今盡遷之江北，更調高郵、泰州兩萬戶漢軍戍之。

translations.literal: Ningguo and Huizhou at first used local soldiers; later all colluded with bandits; now all were moved north of the river; Gaoyou and Taizhou two wanhu Han troops were transferred to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo and Huizhou local troops had colluded with bandits and were replaced by Gaoyou and Taizhou Han wanhu.

sentences.zh: 揚州、建康、鎮江三城，跨據大江，人民繁會，置七萬戶府。

translations.literal: Yangzhou, Jiankang, and Zhenjiang three cities straddled the Great River with dense populations—a seventy-thousand-household command was established.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou, Jiankang, and Zhenjiang on the Yangzi received a 70,000-household command.

sentences.zh: 杭州行省諸司府庫所在，置四萬戶府。

translations.literal: Hangzhou, where the circuit's offices and treasuries were located—a forty-thousand-household command was established.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou, seat of provincial offices, received a 40,000-household command.

sentences.zh: 水戰之法，舊止十所，今擇瀕海沿江要害二十二所，分後閱習，伺察諸盜。

translations.literal: Naval warfare methods: formerly only ten posts; now twenty-two key coastal and river points were chosen for rotation, training, and watching bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Naval posts increased from ten to twenty-two key coastal and river stations.

sentences.zh: 錢塘控扼海口，舊置戰艦二十艘，今增置戰艦百艘，海船二十艘。」

translations.literal: Qiantang controlled the sea mouth; formerly twenty warships were placed; now one hundred warships and twenty sea ships were added."
translations.idiomatic: Qiantang's fleet grew from 20 to 100 warships plus 20 sea vessels.

sentences.zh: 樞密院以聞，悉從之。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs reported this; all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs approved all proposals.

sentences.zh: 二十八年二月，調江淮省探馬赤軍及漢軍二千人，於脫歡太子側近揚州屯駐。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-eighth year, two thousand reconnaissance cavalry and Han troops of Jiang-Huai Circuit were mobilized to encamp near Prince Toγon at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1291 2,000 Jiang-Huai reconnaissance and Han troops encamped near Prince Toγon at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，以咸平府、東京所屯新附軍五百人，增戍女直地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, five hundred new-subject troops encamped at Xianping and Eastern Capital were increased to garrison Jurchen lands.
translations.idiomatic: In 1292 500 new-subject troops from Xianping and Eastern Capital reinforced Jurchen garrisons.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月，詔西征探馬赤軍八千人，分留一千或二千，餘令放還。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirtieth year, an edict: eight thousand western campaign reconnaissance cavalry—each place was to retain one or two thousand; the rest were released to return.
translations.idiomatic: In January 1293 of 8,000 western campaign reconnaissance cavalry, 1,000–2,000 were retained locally; the rest went home.

sentences.zh: 皇子奧魯赤、大王術伯言，切恐軍散釁生，宜留四千，還四千，從之。

translations.literal: Prince Orγoch and Great King Shibo said they greatly feared that if troops dispersed trouble would arise; eight thousand should remain, four thousand return—this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Orγoch and King Shibo feared dispersal would cause unrest; 4,000 were kept, 4,000 released—approved.

sentences.zh: 五月，命思播黃平、鎮遠拘刷亡宋避役手號軍人，以增鎮守。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an order to the Sibao, Huangping, and Zhenyuan circuits to round up escaped Song labor-register soldiers to augment garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In May Sibao, Huangping, and Zhenyuan were to conscript escaped Song labor troops for garrison.

sentences.zh: 七月，調四川行院新附軍一千人，戍松山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, one thousand new-subject troops of Sichuan Circuit were mobilized to garrison Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In July 1,000 Sichuan new-subject troops garrisoned Songshan.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，江浙行省言：「近以鎮守建康、太平保定萬戶府全翼軍馬七千二百一十二名，調屬湖廣省，乞分兩淮戍兵，於本省沿海鎮遏。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, Jiang-Zhe Circuit said: "Recently the seven thousand two hundred twelve men of the full wing of the Jiankang, Taiping, and Baoding wanhu garrison were transferred to Huguang Circuit; We request dividing Huai-South garrison troops for coastal restraint in this circuit."
translations.idiomatic: In May 1295 Jiang-Zhe reported 7,212 Jiankang-Taiping-Baoding garrison troops had been sent to Huguang and asked Huai-South troops for coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 樞密院官議：「沿江軍馬，系伯顏、阿術安置，勿令改動，止於本省元管千戶、百戶軍內，發兵鎮守之。」

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs officials discussed: "Yangzi River troops were placed by Bayan and Aju—do not let them be changed; only from this circuit's original chiliarch and centurion troops send soldiers for garrison."
translations.idiomatic: The bureau ruled Yangzi garrisons placed by Bayan and Aju must not be altered; only existing Jiang-Zhe chiliarch and centurion troops could be used.

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔以兩廣海外四州城池戍兵，歲一更代，往來勞苦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict: because garrison soldiers of the four prefectures' cities beyond the seas of the two Guang regions were rotated yearly, coming and going in hardship and toil.
translations.idiomatic: In September an edict noted that garrison troops in the four overseas prefectures of the two Guang circuits were rotated yearly at great hardship.

sentences.zh: 給俸錢，選良醫，往治其疾病者。

translations.literal: Salary money was granted; good physicians were selected to go treat those with illness.
translations.idiomatic: They were granted pay, and skilled physicians were sent to treat the sick.

sentences.zh: 命三二年一更代之。

translations.literal: An order was given for rotation every three or two years.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation was set at two or three years.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，調揚州翼鄧新萬戶府全翼軍馬，分屯蘄、黃。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, the full wing troops and horses of Yangzhou wing Deng Xin Wanhu Office were mobilized to encamp separately at Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1296 Yangzhou's Deng Xin wanhu full wing was split to garrison Qi and Huang.

sentences.zh: 大德元年三月，陜西平章政事脫烈伯領總帥府軍三千人，收捕西番回，詔留總帥軍百人及階州舊軍、禿思馬軍各二百人守階州，餘軍還元翼。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Dade, Shaanxi Pacification Commissioner Teliebo led three thousand troops of the headquarters army to capture Western Fan rebels; an edict retained one hundred headquarters troops and two hundred each of Jiezhou old troops and Tusima troops to guard Jiezhou; the rest returned to their original wings.
translations.idiomatic: In March 1297 Teliebo of Shaanxi led 3,000 headquarters troops against western rebels; 100 headquarters men and 200 each from Jiezhou and Tusima garrisoned Jiezhou; the rest returned home.

sentences.zh: 湖廣省請以保定翼萬人，移鎮郴州，樞密院官議：「此翼乃張柔所領征伐舊軍，宜遷入鄂州省屯駐，別調兵守之。」

translations.literal: Huguang Circuit requested moving ten thousand men of the Baoding wing to garrison Chenzhou; Bureau of Military Affairs officials discussed: "This wing is the old campaign army led by Zhang Rou; it should be moved to encamp in Ezhou Circuit; separately mobilize troops to guard it."
translations.idiomatic: Huguang asked to move 10,000 Baoding-wing troops to Chenzhou; the bureau ruled they were Zhang Rou's old campaign force and should camp at Ezhou while other troops guarded Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，招收亡宋左右兩江土軍千人，從思明上思等處都元帥昔剌不花言也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, one thousand native troops of the extinguished Song's Left and Right Two Rivers were recruited, at the request of Grand Marshal Sirap Buka of Siming and Shangsi.
translations.idiomatic: In July 1,000 Song Two Rivers native troops were recruited at Sirap Buka's request.

sentences.zh: 十一月，河南行省言：「前揚州立江淮行省，江陵立荊湖行省，各統軍馬，上下鎮遏。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Henan Circuit said: "Formerly Yangzhou established the Jiang-Huai Circuit, Jiangling established the Jing-Hu Circuit, each commanding troops for restraint above and below.
translations.idiomatic: In November Henan reported that Yangzhou had once headed Jiang-Huai and Jiangling Jing-Hu, each commanding troops for mutual restraint.

sentences.zh: 後江淮省移於杭州，荊湖省遷於鄂州，黃河之南，大江迤北，汴梁古郡設立河南江北行省，通管江淮、荊湖兩省元有地面。

translations.literal: Later Jiang-Huai Circuit moved to Hangzhou, Jing-Hu Circuit moved to Ezhou; south of the Yellow River and north of the Great River, at the ancient commandery of Bianliang the Henan and Jiangbei Circuit was established, comprehensively governing the former territories of Jiang-Huai and Jing-Hu two circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai later moved to Hangzhou and Jing-Hu to Ezhou; Bianliang then became Henan-Jiangbei, governing both former circuits' lands south of the Yellow River and north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 近來並入軍馬，通行管領，所屬之地，大江最為緊要，兩淮地險人頑，宋亡之後，始來歸順。

translations.literal: Recently troops were merged for comprehensive command; of subordinate lands, the Great River was most critical; the two Huai lands were perilous and people stubborn—only after Song's fall did they come to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were now merged under one command; the Yangzi was the most critical sector, and the stubborn two Huai region had submitted only after Song's fall.

sentences.zh: 當時沿江一帶，斟酌緩急，安置定三十一翼軍馬鎮遏，後遷調十二翼前去江南，餘有一十九翼，於內調發，止存元額十分中一二。

translations.literal: At that time along the river belt, weighing urgency and ease, thirty-one wings of troops were settled for restraint; later twelve wings were transferred to Jiangnan; of the remaining nineteen wings, internal mobilization left only one or two tenths of the original quota.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-one wings had once guarded the river; twelve were later sent to Jiangnan, leaving barely a tenth of the original nineteen.

sentences.zh: 況兩淮、荊襄自古隘要之地，歸附至今，雖即寧靜，宜慮未然。

translations.literal: Moreover the two Huai and Jing-Xiang have since antiquity been strategic passes; though quiet since submission, the unforeseen should be considered.
translations.idiomatic: The two Huai and Jing-Xiang remained strategically vital; though calm since submission, future trouble had to be anticipated.

sentences.zh: 乞照沿江元置軍馬，遷調江南翼分，並各省所占本省軍人，發還元翼，仍前鎮遏。」

translations.literal: We request following the former river garrison troops, returning Jiangnan wings and soldiers occupied by each circuit to their original wings, and restoring former restraint."
translations.idiomatic: They asked to restore original river garrisons, return borrowed Jiangnan wings, and recover provincial troops for restraint duty.

sentences.zh: 省院官議，以為沿江安置三十一翼軍馬之說，本院無此簿書，問之河南省官孛魯歡，其省亦無樞密院文卷，內但稱至元十九年，伯顏、玉速鐵木兒等共擬其地安置三萬二千軍，後增二千，總三萬四千，今悉令各省差占及逃亡事故者還充役足矣。

translations.literal: Circuit and bureau officials discussed: as for the statement of thirty-one wings along the river, this bureau has no such register; asking Henan official Bolughan, that circuit also has no Bureau archives—within it only says in the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, Bayan, Yus Temür, and others jointly planned garrison of thirty-two thousand troops, later increased by two thousand, totaling thirty-four thousand; now ordering each circuit to make up shortages from desertion and casualties suffices for filling service.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and bureau officials found no record of thirty-one wings; Bolughan cited Kublai's 1282 plan for 34,000 river troops and said shortages could be filled from deserters and casualties.

sentences.zh: 又孛魯歡言，去年伯顏點視河南省見有軍五萬二百之上，又若還其占役事故軍人，則共有七八萬人。

translations.literal: Again Bolughan said, last year Bayan inspected Henan and saw more than fifty-two thousand troops; if returned occupied-service and casualty soldiers, there would be seventy to eighty thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: Bolughan added Bayan had counted over 52,000 Henan troops last year, rising to 70–80,000 if borrowed and casualty men returned.

sentences.zh: 此數之外，脫歡太子位下有一千探馬赤、一千漢軍，阿剌八赤等哈剌魯亦在其地，設有非常，皆可調用。

translations.literal: Beyond this number, under Prince Toγon's establishment were one thousand reconnaissance cavalry and one thousand Han troops; Qarluq of Arigh Boke and others were also in that region—if there were emergency, all could be mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Besides those, Prince Toγon had 1,000 reconnaissance cavalry and 1,000 Han troops, with Qarluq forces nearby—all available in emergency.

sentences.zh: 據各省占役，總計軍官、軍人一萬三千八百八十一名，軍官二百九名，軍人一萬三千六百七十二名，內漢軍五千五百八十名，新附軍八千二十八名，蒙古軍六十四名。

translations.literal: According to each circuit's occupied service, totaling military officers and soldiers thirteen thousand eight hundred eighty-one: two hundred nine officers, thirteen thousand six hundred seventy-two soldiers—within them five thousand five hundred eighty Han soldiers, eight thousand twenty-eight new-subject soldiers, sixty-four Mongol soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Occupied-service troops totaled 13,881: 209 officers and 13,672 soldiers—5,580 Han, 8,028 new-subject, and 64 Mongol.

sentences.zh: 江浙省占役軍官、軍人四千九百五十七名，湖廣省占役軍官、軍人七千六百三名，福建省占役軍官、軍人一千二百七十二名，江西省出征收捕未回新附軍四十九名，悉令還役。」

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe occupied four thousand nine hundred fifty-seven; Huguang seven thousand six hundred three; Fujian one thousand two hundred seventy-two; Jiangxi had forty-nine new-subject troops on campaign not yet returned—all were ordered back to service.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe held 4,957, Huguang 7,603, Fujian 1,272; Jiangxi's 49 campaigning new-subject troops were also recalled.

sentences.zh: 江浙省亦言：「河南行省見占本省軍人八千八百三十三名，亦宜遣還鎮遏。」

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe Circuit also said: "Henan Circuit now occupies eight thousand eight hundred thirty-three soldiers of this circuit; they too should be sent back for restraint."
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe added Henan held 8,833 of its troops and should return them for garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 有旨，兩省各差官赴闕辨議。

translations.literal: An edict was issued that both circuits each send officials to the court for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Both circuits were ordered to send officials to court for adjudication.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，樞密院臣言：「阿剌䴙、脫忽思所領漢人、女直、高麗等軍二千一百三十六名內，有稱海對陣者，有久戍四五年者，物力消乏，乞於六衛軍內分一千二百人，大同屯田軍八百人，徹裏臺軍二百人，總二千二百人往代之。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, Bureau of Military Affairs officials said: "Of the two thousand one hundred thirty-six Han, Jurchen, Koryo, and other troops led by Arigh and Toghos, some claim sea-battle service, some have garrisoned four or five years—their material strength is exhausted; We request from the six guards dividing one thousand two hundred men, Datong garrison-farm troops eight hundred, and Cherigten troops two hundred—total two thousand two hundred—to replace them."
translations.idiomatic: In January 1298 the bureau proposed replacing 2,136 exhausted Arigh and Toghos troops—some veterans of four or five years' garrison—with 2,200 fresh men from the six guards, Datong farms, and Cherigten units.

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔各省合並鎮守軍，福建所置者合為五十三所，江浙所置者合為二百二十七所，江西元立屯軍鎮守二百二十六所，減去一百六十二所，存六十四所。

translations.literal: In the third month, an edict merged garrison troops of each circuit: Fujian's establishments combined to fifty-three posts; Jiang-Zhe's to two hundred twenty-seven; Jiangxi's original two hundred twenty-six garrison-farm posts were reduced by one hundred sixty-two, retaining sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In March garrison posts were consolidated: Fujian to 53, Jiang-Zhe to 227, Jiangxi from 226 to 64.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，沅州賊人嘯聚，命以毗陽萬戶府鎮守辰州，鎮巢萬戶府鎮守沅州、靖州，上均萬戶府鎮守常德、澧州。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, Yuanzhou bandits gathered; an order placed Piyang wanhu to garrison Chenzhou, Zhenchao wanhu to garrison Yuan and Jing, and Shangjun wanhu to garrison Changde and Li.
translations.idiomatic: In March 1299 Yuanzhou unrest led to posting Piyang wanhu at Chenzhou, Zhenchao at Yuan and Jing, and Shangjun at Changde and Li.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，詔河南省占役江浙省軍一萬一千四百七十二名，除洪澤、芍陂屯田外，餘令發還元翼。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, an edict: Henan Circuit's occupied Jiang-Zhe troops of eleven thousand four hundred seventy-two, except Hongze and Shaobei garrison farms, the rest were sent back to original wings.
translations.idiomatic: In March 1301 Henan was ordered to return 11,472 borrowed Jiang-Zhe troops except Hongze and Shaobei farm detachments.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，調碉門四川軍一千人，鎮守羅羅斯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year, one thousand Diaomen Sichuan troops were mobilized to garrison Luolusi.
translations.idiomatic: In April 1303 1,000 Diaomen Sichuan troops garrisoned Luolusi.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，以江南海口軍少，調蘄縣王萬戶翼漢軍一百人、寧萬戶翼漢軍一百人、新附軍三百人守慶元，自乃顏來者蒙古軍三百人守定海。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, because Jiangnan sea-mouth troops were few, one hundred Han troops of Qi county Wang wanhu wing, one hundred Han troops of Ning wanhu wing, and three hundred new-subject troops were ordered to guard Qingyuan; three hundred Mongol troops from Nayan's followers guarded Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: In February 1304, with few sea-mouth troops, 100 Wang-wanhu Han, 100 Ning-wanhu Han, and 300 new-subject troops guarded Qingyuan; 300 of Nayan's Mongols guarded Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大二年七月，樞密院臣言：「去年日本商船焚掠慶元，官軍不能敵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Zhida under Wuzong, Bureau of Military Affairs officials said: "Last year Japanese merchant ships burned and plundered Qingyuan; government troops could not resist.
translations.idiomatic: In July 1309 the bureau reported Japanese merchant raiders had burned Qingyuan the year before and government troops could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 江浙省言，請以慶元、臺州沿海萬戶府新附軍往陸路鎮守，以蘄縣、宿州兩萬戶府陸路漢軍移就沿海屯鎮。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe Circuit said, requesting coastal wanhu new-subject troops of Qingyuan and Taizhou for inland garrison, and moving Qi and Suzhou wanhu inland Han troops to coastal encampment garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe proposed swapping coastal new-subject troops inland and moving Qi and Suzhou Han wanhu to the coast.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，自世祖時，伯顏、阿術等相地之勢，制事之宜，然後安置軍馬，豈可輕動。

translations.literal: We your ministers discuss: from Shizu's time, Bayan, Aju, and others gauged terrain's tendencies and affairs' fitness, then placed troops—how can this be lightly changed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers replied that Bayan and Aju had placed troops according to terrain and should not be lightly rearranged.

sentences.zh: 前行省忙古䴙等亦言，以水陸軍互換遷調，世祖有訓曰：『忙古䴙得非狂醉而發此言！

translations.literal: The former circuit Mangγut also spoke, saying naval and land forces should be mutually exchanged and transferred; Shizu had instruction saying: "Has Mangγut not gone mad drunk to issue such words!
translations.idiomatic: Former governor Mangγut had proposed swapping naval and land troops; Kublai had rebuked him: "Is Mangγut drunk mad to say this!

sentences.zh: 以水路之兵習陸路之伎，驅步騎之士而從風水之役，難成易敗，於事何補。』

translations.literal: Making naval troops practice land skills, driving steppe and cavalry soldiers to follow wind-and-water service—hard to succeed, easy to fail; what help to affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Training sailors for land warfare and sending cavalry to naval duty succeeds with difficulty and fails easily—it helps nothing."

sentences.zh: 今欲禦備奸宄，莫若從宜於水路沿海萬戶府新附軍三分取一，與陸路蘄縣萬戶府漢軍相參鎮守。」

translations.literal: Now to prepare against treachery, it is best as convenient to take one-third of coastal wanhu new-subject naval troops and mix with inland Qi county wanhu Han troops for joint garrison."
translations.idiomatic: For coastal defense they proposed taking one-third of coastal new-subject naval troops to join Qi county Han wanhu in mixed garrison.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，以江浙省嘗言：「兩浙沿海瀕江隘口，地接諸蕃，海寇出沒，兼收附江南之後，三十餘年，承平日久，將驕卒惰，帥領不得其人，軍馬安置不當，乞斟酌沖要去處，遷調鎮遏。」

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, because Jiang-Zhe Circuit had said: "Along the two Zhe coasts at river passes bordering various barbarians, sea bandits appear and vanish; moreover after receiving Jiangnan, for more than thirty years in prolonged peace, generals are arrogant and soldiers lazy, commanders are not the right men, and troops are improperly posted—we request weighing strategic passes and transferring garrison restraint."
translations.idiomatic: In October 1311 Jiang-Zhe cited thirty years of peace, arrogant commanders, and poor postings along the Zhe coast and asked redeployment at key passes.

sentences.zh: 樞密院官議：「慶元與日本相接，且為倭商焚毀，宜如所請，其餘遷調軍馬，事關機務，別議行之。」

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs officials discussed: "Qingyuan adjoins Japan and was burned by Japanese merchants; it should follow the request; as for other transferred troops, it concerns military affairs and will be separately deliberated."
translations.idiomatic: The bureau approved changes for Japan-facing Qingyuan but deferred other transfers.

sentences.zh: 十二月，雲南八百媳婦、大、小徹裏等作耗，調四川省蒙古、漢軍四千人，命萬戶囊加䴙部領，赴雲南鎮守。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Yunnan's Babai Xifu, Great and Small Cherig, and others made trouble; four thousand Mongol and Han troops of Sichuan Circuit were mobilized, ordered led by Wanhu Nangaji to proceed to Yunnan for garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In December Yunnan unrest led to 4,000 Sichuan Mongol and Han troops under Wanhu Nangaji.

sentences.zh: 其四川省言：「本省地方，東南控接荊湖，西北襟連秦隴，阻山帶江，密邇蕃蠻，素號天險，古稱極邊重地，乞於存恤歇役六年軍內，調二千人往。」

translations.literal: Sichuan Circuit said: "This circuit's territory southeast connects Jing-Hu, northwest links Qin and Long, blocks mountains and embraces rivers, closely adjoins fan barbarians—always called heaven's hazard, anciently termed the utmost frontier heavy ground; We request from troops rested six years after relief, mobilizing two thousand to go."
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan argued it was a vital frontier and asked 2,000 men from troops rested six years after relief.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 仁宗皇慶元年十一月，詔江西省瘴地內諸路鎮守軍，各移近地屯駐。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Huangqing under Renzong, an edict: garrison troops of routes within Jiangxi Circuit's malarial lands were each moved to encamp at nearer places.
translations.idiomatic: In November 1312 Renzong ordered Jiangxi malarial-zone garrisons moved to healthier stations.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年四月，河南行省言：「本省地方寬廣，關系非輕，所屬萬戶府俱於臨江沿淮上下鎮守方面，相離省府，近者千里之上，遠者二千餘里，不測調度，卒難相應。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Yanyou, Henan Circuit said: "This circuit's territory is broad and the connection is not light; subordinate wanhu offices are all at river crossings along the Huai above and below for frontier restraint, separated from the provincial seat—nearest more than a thousand li, farthest more than two thousand li—unexpected mobilization is hard to respond to in time.
translations.idiomatic: In April 1317 Henan complained its wanhu were posted 1,000–2,000 li from the capital along the Huai, hindering emergency response.

sentences.zh: 況汴梁系國家腹心之地，設立行省，別無親臨軍馬，較之江浙、江西、湖廣、陜西、四川等處，俱有隨省軍馬，惟本省未蒙撥付。」

translations.literal: Moreover Bianliang is the state's vital-center land; establishing a circuit with no personally commanded troops—in comparison with Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other places, all have circuit-attached troops; only this circuit has not received allocation."
translations.idiomatic: Bianliang was the dynastic heartland, yet Henan alone lacked dedicated circuit troops unlike other provinces.

sentences.zh: 樞密院以聞，命於山東河北蒙古軍、河南淮北蒙古軍兩都萬戶府，調軍一千人與之。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs reported this; an order mobilized one thousand troops from Shandong-Hebei Mongol troops and Henan-Huaibei Mongol troops two metropolitan wanhu commands to it.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau ordered 1,000 troops from the Shandong-Hebei and Henan-Huaibei metropolitan wanhu commands.

sentences.zh: 十一月，陜西都萬戶府言：「碉門探馬赤軍一百五十名，鎮守多年，乞放還元翼。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Shaanxi Metropolitan Wanhu Office said: "One hundred fifty Diaomen reconnaissance cavalry have garrisoned many years; We request release to original wings."
translations.idiomatic: In November Shaanxi's metropolitan wanhu asked to release 150 long-serving Diaomen reconnaissance cavalry.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣議：「彼中亦系要地，不宜放還，止令於元翼起遣一百五十名，三年一更鎮守。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs officials discussed: "That region is also a key place and should not be released; only order one hundred fifty dispatched from original wings, rotating garrison every three years.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau refused release but ordered triennial rotation of 150 replacements from home wings.

sentences.zh: 元調四川各翼漢軍一千名，鎮守碉門、黎、雅，亦令一體更代。」

translations.literal: The originally mobilized one thousand Han troops of Sichuan various wings garrisoning Diaomen, Li, and Ya are also ordered to rotate together."
translations.idiomatic: The 1,000 Sichuan Han troops at Diaomen, Li, and Ya were likewise put on rotation."

sentences.zh: 泰定四年三月，陜西行省嘗言：「奉元建立行省、行臺，別無軍府，唯有蒙古軍都萬戶府，遠在鳳翔置司，相離三百五十餘里，緩急難用。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Taiding, Shaanxi Circuit once said: "Fengyuan established a circuit and surveillance commission but has no military office; only the Mongol Metropolitan Wanhu Office, far at Fengxiang, is separated by more than three hundred fifty li—urgent matters are hard to use.
translations.idiomatic: In March 1327 Shaanxi noted Fengyuan's circuit lacked nearby troops; the Mongol metropolitan wanhu at Fengxiang was 350 li away.

sentences.zh: 乞移都萬戶府於奉元置司，軍民兩便。」

translations.literal: We request moving the metropolitan wanhu office to Fengyuan to establish its bureau—for military and civilian, both convenient."
translations.idiomatic: It asked to move the metropolitan wanhu bureau to Fengyuan for convenience.

sentences.zh: 及後陜西都萬戶府言：「自大德三年命移司酌中安置，經今三十餘年，鳳翔離大都、土番、甘肅俱各三千里，地面酌中，不移為便。」

translations.literal: Later Shaanxi Metropolitan Wanhu said: "From the third year of Dade an order moved the bureau to a balanced placement; for more than thirty years now, Fengxiang is three thousand li from the capital, Tubo, and Gansu—its ground is balanced in the middle; not moving is convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Later the metropolitan wanhu argued Fengxiang had been centrally placed since 1299 and should not move.

sentences.zh: 樞密議：「陜西舊例，未嘗提調軍馬，況鳳翔置司三十餘年，不宜移動。」

translations.literal: The Bureau discussed: "Shaanxi's old precedent never mobilized troops; moreover Fengxiang's bureau has stood more than thirty years and should not be moved."
translations.idiomatic: The bureau ruled Shaanxi had never centrally mobilized troops and the Fengxiang bureau should stay.

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，河南行省言：「所轄之地，東連淮、海，南限大江，北抵黃河，西接關陜，洞蠻草賊出沒，與民為害。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Henan Circuit said: "Territory governed adjoins east to the Huai and sea, south is bounded by the Great River, north reaches the Yellow River, west connects Guan and Long; cave barbarians and grass bandits appear and vanish, harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: In December Henan reported bandits between the Huai, Yangzi, Yellow River, and Guan-Long frontiers harming the people.

sentences.zh: 本省軍馬俱在瀕海沿江安置，遠者二千，近者一千餘里，乞以炮手、弩軍兩翼，移於汴梁，並各萬戶府摘軍五千名，設萬戶府隨省鎮遏。」

translations.literal: This circuit's troops are all posted along the sea and river; far ones two thousand, near ones more than a thousand li; We request moving artillery and crossbow wings to Bianliang, and from each wanhu selecting five thousand troops to establish a wanhu office accompanying the circuit for restraint."
translations.idiomatic: Henan asked to move artillery and crossbow wings to Bianliang and create a 5,000-man circuit wanhu from existing units.

sentences.zh: 樞密院議：「自至元十九年，世祖命知地理省院官共議，於瀕海沿江六十三處安置軍馬。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs discussed: "From the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, Shizu ordered officials knowing geography of circuit and bureau jointly to discuss garrison of troops at sixty-three places along the sea and river.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau cited Kublai's 1282 plan placing troops at sixty-three coastal and river posts.

sentences.zh: 時汴梁未嘗置軍，揚州沖要重地，置五翼軍馬並炮手、弩軍。

translations.literal: At that time Bianliang had not yet placed troops; Yangzhou, a vital strategic place, had five wings of troops and artillery and crossbow troops placed.
translations.idiomatic: Bianliang then had no garrison; vital Yangzhou had five wings plus artillery and crossbow troops.

sentences.zh: 今親王脫歡太子鎮遏揚州，提調四省軍馬，此軍不宜更動。

translations.literal: Now Imperial Prince Toγon guards Yangzhou and commands four circuits' troops; these troops should not be further changed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Toγon now commanded Yangzhou and four circuits' troops, which should not be moved.

sentences.zh: 設若河南省果用軍，則不塔剌吉所管四萬戶蒙古軍內，三萬戶在黃河之南、河南省之西，一萬戶在河南省之南，脫別臺所管五萬戶蒙古軍俱在黃河之北、河南省東北，阿剌鐵木兒、安童等兩侍衛蒙古軍在河南省之北，共十一衛翼蒙古軍馬，俱在河南省周圍屯駐。

translations.literal: If Henan Circuit truly uses troops, then within Notaghachi's forty thousand households of Mongol troops, thirty thousand are south of the Yellow River and west of Henan Circuit; ten thousand are south of Henan Circuit; Tögetei's fifty thousand households of Mongol troops are all north of the Yellow River and northeast of Henan; Arigh Temür and Antong's two personal guard Mongol forces are north of Henan Circuit—altogether eleven guard-wing Mongol forces encamp surrounding Henan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: If needed, 110,000 Mongol troops in eleven guard wings already surrounded Henan under Notaghachi, Tögetei, and the personal guards.

sentences.zh: 又本省所轄一十九翼軍馬，俱在河南省之南，沿江置列。

translations.literal: Again this circuit's nineteen wings of troops are all south of Henan Circuit, arrayed along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's own nineteen wings also lined the river south of the province.

sentences.zh: 果用兵，即馳奏於諸軍馬內調發。」

translations.literal: If troops are used, then urgently memorialize and mobilize from among the various troops."
translations.idiomatic: Any deployment could be ordered by urgent memorial from these forces.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.
